title: Nashville Famous Footsteps Guided Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step into the rhythm of Nashville, where every street has a story and every note carries a legacy. On this unforgettable journey through the heart of “Music City,” you’ll uncover the lives and landmarks that shaped American music history. From the soulful sounds of Patsy Cline to the rebellious spirit of Johnny Cash, from the charm of Dolly Parton to the timeless influence of Elvis Presley, this tour celebrates the legends who put Nashville on the map.

Stroll past historic venues, recording studios, and hidden gems that helped launch the careers of Hank Williams, Willie Nelson, Keith Urban, and countless others. Along the way, you’ll hear fascinating tales of Tom Ryman and the iconic Ryman Auditorium — the “Mother Church of Country Music” — and gain a deeper appreciation for the people and places that made this city sing.
